title: The Cutting Edge: Week of June 28th
body:
**Highlights**
- Introducing [Kabocha](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1415-kabocha-kab-a-ksm-parachain-from-edgeware), a community-owned KSM parachain & canarynet from Edgeware.
- [Live demonstration of ETH-EDG bridge](https://youtu.be/zyIfpMFIHtg) on Beresheet EVM (aka Edgeware Testnet EVM) powered by ChainSafe Systems and dTrade is now publicly available.
- Market Across shared their [campaign report for the month of June 2021](https://share.coveragebook.com/b/2e8b824f3ae436b3).


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- The treasury funding proposal for [Core community dev Ramsey Ajram](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1327-edgeware-road-parachains-and-bridges-core-development) has been passed as Referendum 44. {Treasury Proposal ID:35, Referendum type: SimpleMajorityApprove, Council Motion ID: 50}
- The treasury funding proposal for [Exit Theory: A Content and Community Project](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1131-exit-theory-a-content-and-community-project) by Justin Murphy has been passed as Referendum 45. {Treasury Proposal ID:36, Referendum type: SimpleMajorityApprove, Council Motion ID: 51} 


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
